## Incident postmortem: expired TLS certificate

On February 3, our TLS certificate expired, and the service was degraded for 47 minutes, from 09:12 to 09:59 UTC. During that window, 18% of requests failed.

We had no alert for certificate expiry, so nothing warned us before the date passed. We only found out once users started hitting errors.

Service was fully restored by 09:59. Our top priority now is adding monitoring and alerts for certificate expiry, so we know about renewals well before a certificate runs out.
